description:
Flamingo is a searchable map for the next big open world. Every named place, story mission and collectible gets a pin, and you can find any of them by typing a few letters.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Browse six regions on one map, from the Keys to the mountains
- Search places, regions, missions and collectibles in one field; the matches stay on the map as lettered pins
- Type the completion percent from your save and Flamingo guesses your next mission, then tick missions off as you play
- Count collectibles as you find them
- Long-press to drop your own pin with a note, and star places to save them
- Mission names stay hidden until you turn spoilers on

Your progress lives on your device. Sign in with email only if you want it on every device, and delete the account any time in Settings.

Flamingo is an unofficial fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive, and uses no game art or map imagery. Grand Theft Auto is a trademark of Take-Two Interactive. Pins are approximate.
promotionalText: Every place, mission and collectible on one searchable map. Free, no ads.
